biotools.summary: Riana is an R-based software tool for protein turnover analysis utilizing heavy water labeling mass spectrometry. It improves the coverage of well-fitted peptides by employing a reverse lookup method for isotopomer profiles and automated selection of isotopomer pairs based on peptide sequence.
